name: quick-spec
description: Kiro mode: the same three spec documents in one pass, no pauses (Kiro Spec & Plan)
prompt: This agent is a handle for Kiro's built-in Quick Spec mode, which the kiro-cli v3 engine (KAS) activates by name.
